title: Input file

type.description: The type of the input item. Always `input_file`.

anyOf.description: The ID of the file to be sent to the model.

filename.description: The name of the file to be sent to the model.

file_data.description: The content of the file to be sent to the model.

file_url.description: The URL of the file to be sent to the model.

detail.description: The detail level of the file to be sent to the model. Use `auto` to let the system select the detail level; for GPT-5.6 and later models, `auto` uses high-quality rendering, which may increase input token usage. Use `low` for lower-cost rendering, or `high` to render the file at higher quality. Defaults to `auto`.

description: A file input to the model.
